# Main: UMAP and PCA of oligodendrocytes by location
```{r}
seurat.obj.gbm.oligos$location <- factor(seurat.obj.gbm.oligos$location, levels = sample.locations)
sample.location.legend.labels <- get.count.labels(seurat.obj.gbm.oligos$location, sample.location.colors)
p <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.gbm.oligos, group.by = "location", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=F) + 
  ggtitle("Location") + 
  sample.location.legend.labels +
  umap.axes
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "GBM_samples_UMAP_by_location.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()

p <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.gbm.oligos, group.by = "location", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=F, reduction = "pca") + 
  ggtitle("Location") + 
  sample.location.legend.labels
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "GBM_samples_pca_by_location.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Demyelination and remyelination signatures
```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)

res <- lm(acute.demyelination ~ apoptosis.signature, data = seurat.obj.gbm.oligos@meta.data)
seurat.obj.gbm.oligos$acute.demyelination.res <- res$residuals

res <- lm(acute.de.re.myelination ~ apoptosis.signature, data = seurat.obj.gbm.oligos@meta.data)
seurat.obj.gbm.oligos$acute.de.re.myelination.res <- res$residuals


# split Seurat object and comparisons by method
seurat.obj.subset <- seurat.obj.gbm.oligos
unique(seurat.obj.subset$sample.id)
seurat.obj.subset.facs <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = (method == "FACS"))
seurat.obj.subset.facs$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj.subset.facs$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)
comparisons.facs <- list(c("GBM 1 Edge", "GBM 1 Distal"), c("GBM 1 Core", "GBM 1 Edge"), c("GBM 1 Core", "GBM 1 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Distal Inf.", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Edge", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Brainstem", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Core", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("IDH-mut 1 Edge", "IDH-mut 1 Distal"))

p <- do.boxplot(data = seurat.obj.subset.facs@meta.data, 
           x.variable = "sample.desc",
           y.variable = "acute.demyelination.res",
           output.filepath = paste0(supp.figures.dir, "GBM_FACS_sample_vs_demyelination_apoptosis_regressed_denoised.pdf"),
           ylab.label = paste0("Demyelination signature\nin oligodendrocytes"),
           comparisons = comparisons.facs,
           boxplot.fill.variable = "sample.desc",
           fill.scale = sample.descs.fill.scale,
           image.width = 18,
           image.height = 8,
           facet.by = "patient.desc",
           vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress,  
           step.increase = 0.05,
           outlier.shape = NA,

p <- do.boxplot(data = seurat.obj.subset.facs@meta.data, 
           x.variable = "sample.desc",

           output.filepath = paste0(supp.figures.dir, "GBM_FACS_sample_vs_remyelination_apoptosis_regressed_denoised.pdf"),

           fill.scale = sample.descs.fill.scale,

           image.height = 8,
           facet.by = "patient.desc",
           vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress,
           step.increase = 0.05,
           outlier.shape = NA,
           y.adjust = c("GBM 1" = 0, "GBM 2" = 0, "IDH-mut 1" = 0),
           alternative = "greater",
           return.plot = TRUE)

comparisons.facs <- list(c("Edge", "Distal"), c("Core", "Edge"), c("Core", "Distal"))
seurat.obj.subset.facs.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset.facs, subset = location %in% c("Core", "Edge", "Distal"))
```

# Main: Tumor-adjacent oligodendrocyte DEGs volcano plot 
```{r}
tumor.samples.use <- c("GBM 1 Core FACS", "GBM 1 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Core FACS", "GBM 2 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Brainstem FACS")

## Volcano plot of DEGs
markers.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/Figure 4/markers/Oligodendrocytes/")
all.markers.df <- read.csv(paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t")

all.markers.df.filter <- all.markers.df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, sample %in% tumor.samples.use) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(n.samples = n_distinct(sample), 
            n.patients = n_distinct(patient),
            median.avg_log2FC = median(avg_log2FC),
            median.p_val_adj = median(p_val_adj),
            samples.up = paste0(sample, collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n.samples))
summary.df <- all.markers.df.filter

summary.df.filter <- summary.df %>% filter(n.samples >= 4) 


# Volcano plot

immune.interferon.genes <- c("B2M", "STAT3", "NLRC5", "HLA-A") #c("STAT1", "IFI16", "GBP2") 
proteostasis.stress.genes <- c("PDK1", "ATF4", "ACO1") #c("ERO1A", "ATF3") # "EIF2AK2", "GARS",
remodeling.genes <- c("ARHGAP24", "PHACTR1", "ACTG1", "ASAP1") #c("ASAP1", "EPS8", "CD44")
trafficking.genes <- c("BACE2", "GALNT15", "TPST1", "COPA") #c("ANXA2", "SQSTM1", "B4GALT5")
myelin.genes <- c("MBP", "PLP1", "MOG", "ASPA")
other.genes.of.interest <- c("CD44", "VEGFA", "VIM", "HIF1A")

summary.df$gene.category <- sapply(summary.df$gene, function(x) case_when(
  x %in% immune.interferon.genes ~ "Immune & Interferon",
  x %in% proteostasis.stress.genes ~ "Metabolic & Proteotoxic Stress",
  x %in% remodeling.genes ~ "Cytoskeletal Remodeling",
  x %in% trafficking.genes ~ "Trafficking & Glycosylation",
  x %in% myelin.genes ~ "Myelin",
  x %in% other.genes.of.interest ~ "Hypoxia & TME",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
))

summary.df$gene.label <- apply(summary.df, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["gene.category"]] != "Other", row[["gene"]], ""))

gene.category.colors <- c(
  "Immune & Interferon"        = "#D55E00", 
  "Metabolic & Proteotoxic Stress"   = "#0072B2", 
  "Cytoskeletal Remodeling" = "#CC79A7", 
  "Trafficking & Glycosylation"        = "#009E73",
  "Hypoxia & TME"                     = "#E69F00",
  "Myelin"                            = "#000000", 
  "Other"                             = "#999999"
)

gene.categories <- names(gene.category.colors)

gene.categories.color.scale <- scale_color_manual(breaks = gene.categories, values = gene.category.colors)
gene.categories.fill.scale <- scale_fill_manual(breaks = gene.categories, values = gene.category.colors)

summary.df$gene.category <- factor(summary.df$gene.category, levels = gene.categories)
summary.df <- summary.df %>% arrange(desc(gene.category), n.samples)

p <- ggplot(summary.df, aes(median.avg_log2FC, -log10(median.p_val_adj), label = gene.label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n.samples, fill = gene.category), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21) +
  ylab("-log10 adjusted p-value") +
  xlab("log2FC tumor-adjacent vs distal") +
  gene.categories.fill.scale +
  gene.categories.color.scale +
  geom_text_repel(aes(color = gene.category), size = 5, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(fill = "Gene category") +
  labs(size = "No. tumor samples") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) 
  
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_volcano_plot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 7)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Main: Tumor-adjacent oligodendrocyte DEGs GO plot
```{r}
for (deg.direction in c("up", "down")) {
  
  if (deg.direction == "up") {
    genes <- summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% pull(gene)
  } else {
    genes <- summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC < -0.5) %>% pull(gene)
  }
  go.enrich <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                      keyType = 'SYMBOL',
                      ont = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  
  go.enrich.df <- data.frame(go.enrich)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% filter(Count >= 5, Count <= 30)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% arrange(desc(FoldEnrichment))
  
  go.enrich.top.df <- go.enrich.df %>% head(20)
  go.enrich.top.df$Description_short <- str_trunc(go.enrich.top.df$Description, width = 80)
  go.enrich.top.df$Description_short <- factor(go.enrich.top.df$Description_short, levels = rev(go.enrich.top.df$Description_short))
  
  go.enrich.top.df <- go.enrich.top.df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene.category = case_when(
      str_detect(Description, "interferon") ~ "Immune & Interferon",
      str_detect(Description, "folding|starvation|chaperone") ~ "Metabolic & Proteotoxic Stress",
      str_detect(Description, "actin|Rho|Rac") ~ "Cytoskeletal Remodeling",
      str_detect(Description, "vacuole|Golgi|plasma membrane|glycan|glycosphingolipid|endocytosis|synaptic vesicle") ~ "Trafficking & Glycosylation",
      
      # Default for anything that doesn't fit the above
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

  go.enrich.top.df$gene.category <- factor(
    go.enrich.top.df$gene.category,
    levels = gene.categories
  )
  
  # make sure the order matches the plot
  label_colors <- gene.category.colors[
    go.enrich.top.df$gene.category
  ]
  label_colors <- rev(label_colors) # need to reverse to match text
  
  p <- ggplot(
      go.enrich.top.df,
      aes(
        x = FoldEnrichment,
        y = Description_short,
        size = Count,
        color = qvalue
      )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
    ylab("") +
    xlab("Fold enrichment")
  
  if (deg.direction == "up") {
    p <- p + 
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = label_colors)
      )
  }
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_GO_plot_direction=", deg.direction, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  write.table(go.enrich.top.df, paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_GO_plot_direction=", deg.direction, "_table.tsv"), sep = "\t")
}
```



# Main: Reactive oligodendrocyte signatures in oligodendrocytes
```{r}
seurat.obj.subset <- seurat.obj.oligos
seurat.obj.subset$sample.desc.method <- factor(seurat.obj.subset$sample.desc.method, levels = sample.descs.by.method)



# split Seurat object and comparisons by method

seurat.obj.subset.facs$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj.subset.facs$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)
comparisons.facs <- list(c("GBM 1 Edge", "GBM 1 Distal"), c("GBM 1 Core", "GBM 1 Edge"), c("GBM 1 Core", "GBM 1 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Distal Inf.", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Edge", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Brainstem", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("GBM 2 Core", "GBM 2 Distal"), c("IDH-mut 1 Edge", "IDH-mut 1 Distal"))

seurat.obj.subset.10x <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = method == "10X")
seurat.obj.subset.10x$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj.subset.10x$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)
comparisons.10x <- list(c("GBM 2 Edge", "GBM 2 Distal"))

seurat.obj.subset.invent$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj.subset.invent$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)
comparisons.invent <- list(c("GBM 2 Edge", "GBM 2 Distal"))


# reactive oligodendrocyte signature
for (y.var in c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific")) {
  do.boxplot(data = seurat.obj.subset.facs@meta.data, 
             x.variable = "sample.desc",

             output.filepath = paste0(figures.dir, 'oligodendrocytes_sample_vs_', y.var, '_FACS.pdf'),
```
